# TNT House Risk-Data API

> Real-time Solana token safety scores, on-chain-provable insider cluster
> detection, and market fundamentals — built for AI trading agents.
> Free tier: 15 requests/day, no card required. 3 anonymous calls with
> no signup at all. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC on Solana) also
> supported, no API key needed.

Base URL: https://tnt-audit.com
Full OpenAPI 3.1 spec: https://tnt-audit.com/openapi.json
MCP server (stateless, for MCP-native agents): https://tnt-audit.com/api/mcp
Human docs / pricing / signup: https://tnt-audit.com/risk-api

## Core

- [GET /api/v1/token-risk](https://tnt-audit.com/openapi.json): Safety score (0-100), insider funding clusters, mint/freeze authority, honeypot risk, LP lock status, and live market data for one Solana mint. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`.
- [GET /api/v1/token-risk/x402](https://tnt-audit.com/openapi.json): Same response as above, paid per-call via the x402 protocol (HTTP 402 + USDC on Solana) instead of an API key. Built for autonomous agents that don't want to register up front.
- [POST /api/v1/token-risk/batch](https://tnt-audit.com/openapi.json): Same lookup for up to 25 mints in one call, run concurrently. N mints = N calls charged, no bulk discount.
- [GET /api/v1/token-risk/history](https://tnt-audit.com/openapi.json): Hourly safety-score and market history for a mint, up to 90 days back. Free — reads TNT House's own database, not the live upstream, so it doesn't count against your call quota.

## Getting a key

- [POST /api/v1/signup](https://tnt-audit.com/openapi.json): Free-tier API key (15 requests/day) by email, no card. Key is shown once and also emailed as a recovery copy.
- [POST /api/v1/trial/check](https://tnt-audit.com/openapi.json): Anonymous trial, no email at all — 3 checks per browser fingerprint before it points you at signup.

## Webhooks

- [POST /api/v1/webhooks/subscribe](https://tnt-audit.com/openapi.json): Get a signed callback when a mint's safety score crosses a threshold you set (checked every 15 minutes). Subscription cap depends on tier.
- [GET /api/v1/webhooks/subscribe](https://tnt-audit.com/openapi.json): List your own webhook subscriptions.

## Notes for agents

- Every response field is documented in the OpenAPI spec above — read it once rather than guessing field names.
- `cluster_analysis` is `"pending"` on a mint's first-ever check while insider detection runs in the background (usually done within 1-2 minutes); re-check the same mint shortly after for the complete result.
- Rate-limit state is in response headers: `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`, and `X-Credit-Balance-Usd` once a key has a paid tier or credit balance.
- x402 is the fastest path for an agent with a Solana wallet and no interest in managing an API key: first call without payment returns 402 with the price and payTo address; retry with a valid payment header.
